_comment: Single source of truth for headline numbers quoted in docs. All values are the DEFAULT-hyperparameter XGBoost model (models/return_risk_results_{scenario}.json) — the shipped return_risk_xgb_v1.json equivalent — so every number in a scenario row comes from one file (no tuned-vs-default mixing). Tuned champion AUCs live in models/tune_results_{scenario}.json and reports/scenario_comparison.md only. Canonical stack: Python 3.11, numpy 2.2.6, pandas 3.0.3, scipy 1.17.1, scikit-learn 1.9.0, xgboost 3.2.0 (see requirements.txt).
